versions.changelog:
Initial release with powerful Douyin KOL data tools:

- Supports keyword-based video/article search with sorting and filtering options.
- Provides real-time Douyin hot search topics and heat data.
- Allows fetching public works lists via user homepage links or sec_uid.
- Enables comment analysis by video/article link or aweme_id.
- Pure JSON output, no login required, only processes public data.
